verdict.rationale: Runloop documents a devbox Files capability for modifying and interacting with files on the devbox, and says its official SDKs cover "file operations". The evidence never spells out the four operations the story names, though. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of read, write, upload, and download operations as SDK methods, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK
